title: Saturn CG Selection Vol. 1
native_title: サターンＣＧセレクション Ｖｏｌ．１
overview:
Saturn CG Selection (サターンＣＧセレクション) is a digital museum of CG Videos and Images for the Sega Saturn, released exclusively in Japan. It is part of the Saturn Super series of Magazines, with the release being advertised alongside earlier volumes in the series in the "back issues" section of later volumes. Otherwise, it is seemingly a somewhat little known release, and as such is difficult to come by.

The disc contains the CG Intro videos for 8 different Saturn games and bonus CG image galleries for 7 of them. It was included as a bonus to a MOOK (Magazine and Book combo) of the same title, which is thought to contain CG images of the 8 featured games.

All CG videos on the disc are encoded using Cinepak. During the CG Gallery content on the disc, an audio track from the respective game will play in the background, usually from said games CG intro, although this is not always the case (During Panzer Dragoon's CG Image Gallery, the music from the first level plays instead).

Strangely, the audio files that play during the CG Image galleries are actually Cinepak files without a video track, which can sometimes mean that certain sound effects from CG Intro Videos are heard during the galleries (Such as the "shine" sound effect from Clockwork Knight: Pepperouchau no Daibouken Gekan).
